text:
Maya: kicking off a tiny launch pack: short social + a 20m webinar + a cost calculator. focus = latency vs cost tradeoffs.
Luca: thumbs up. keep social to 1 image + 1 GIF. blog gets the long chart with method.
Priya: can infra give a small anonymized table: hosted-default, dedicated-reserved, private-optimized. fields: median_ms, p95_ms, $/1k at 512 tokens.
Maya: copy POV: no "benchmark" publicly, call it a "performance snapshot" or "cost-latency snapshot". short headline only.
Luca: visuals idea: single-panel split - left = bars ($/1k), right = p95 line. alt: combined plot with latency iso-contours for nerdy readers.
Priya: routing for forms: add "Primary priority" (Cost / Latency / Compliance). map Cost->calc email; Latency->AE demo; Compliance->enterprise. hidden field: monthly_tokens estimate.
Maya: social captions: tech = "Match latency SLOs to unit cost across serving modes." biz = "Faster responses or lower bills  pick your priority."
Luca: GIF plan: slider at 100/200/500ms -> three frames showing $/1k delta. use brand blue for Fast, green for Cheap.
Priya: legal note: use "up to X" language for savings and link methodology in blog. avoid specific customer claims without approval.
ops-bot: reminder set for 1746620000 to review final creative. :calendar:
Maya: timeline: infra numbers by EOD Wed, mockups Thu AM, copy + ads Thu PM. will drop drafts here for review. :rocket:
